The story in one sentence
Kamal, 61, falls ill in Mina on his first Hajj, and a Taifafeki doctor reads his medicines and allergies from his Onesan health summary, checked as genuine through WHO GDHCN.

One pilgrim and the people around him, eight moments, one Hajj season. Follow the people first; the technology is what makes each hand-off possible.
